items.title: CVE-2026-132224: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
items.detail: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Catalog addition date is not the attack date.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.detail: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). items.title: CVE-2026-132165: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.detail: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. items.title: Route2Health By the gentlemen
items.detail: route2health.com 235 GB Route2Health (Pvt) Limited is a Pakistani nutraceutical and herbal supplement brand based in Lahore, an associated company of Highnoon Laboratories, a pharmaceutical group operating since 1984. Its key differentiator is that the Sundar Industrial Estate plant in Lahore is Asia's first and the world's ninth USP certified dietary supplement facility, compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 111 GMPs and halal standards. Led by chairman Tausif Ahmad Khan and MD Shahnawaz Baig, it sells premium multivitamins, CoQ10, magnesium, glutathione, herbal cough syrups like Prospan and men's and women's daily formulas. The brand operates in Pakistan, UAE, Canada and Sri Lanka and reaches 12 countries through distributors and alliances with Abbott, Engelhard Arzneimittel and Himalaya. In 2025 the UAE based AZT Foundation acquired a shareholding from the founders in a deal cleared by Pakistan's Competition Commission. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.
